title: Opening the Mindless timer stops reading every member's practice log for the day

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-09: the timer and menus feel gummed up. Speed pass 1, server waterfall review.

detail: loadOnAirSessionData paged through every member's practice_logs row for the member's day (1,000 rows a page, one page after another) on every timer open, only to print 'N members practiced today' when N is 3 or more. It also waited for the member's day lookup before starting any of its other reads. The count is now kept in the server instance for five minutes with one shared in-flight read, a failed read is never kept, and the day lookup runs beside the other reads. The cross-request cache seam was not used on purpose: its census admits only viewer-independent chrome rows. A proper fix at scale is a database-side distinct count, which needs a migration and is a separate row.
